title: Chicken Shepherd’s Pie
ingredients: 1 pound cooked, shredded chicken breast meat
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
½ cup red bell pepper, diced
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Cut head of garlic in half crosswise and drizzle with olive oil. Wrap in foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Peel the potatoes and chop into 1 1/2- to 2-inch cubes; boil until tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Drain, then mash potatoes. Add butter, milk, and roasted garlic and mix in. Set aside.

Arrange chicken evenly in the bottom of a 9x13-inch casserole dish; sprinkle with herbs and spices. Then, layer peppers, corn, and 3/4 cup cheese over the meat. Spread mashed potatoes on top, sealing everything in. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until browned around edges.
